pricingEvidence.evidence: Web search summary: "Lindy AI offers four pricing plans: Plus ($49.99/mo), Pro ($99.99/mo), Max ($199.99/mo), and Enterprise (custom)… As of August 2026, Lindy's live pricing page shows Plus, Pro, Max, and Enterprise with a 7-day free trial and no permanent free tier."

nl.tagline: AI-medewerkers die e-mail, agenda en opvolging afhandelen
nl.description: Met Lindy bouw je AI-agents ('Lindies') voor terugkerend werk: e-mails sorteren en beantwoorden, afspraken plannen, leads opvolgen en meetingnotities verwerken, gekoppeld aan je bestaande apps. Er is een proefperiode maar geen gratis plan.
bestFor: Ondernemers die inbox- en opvolgwerk willen uitbesteden
notFor: Wie volledige technische controle wil (dan eerder n8n)
limitations: Geen gratis plan; verbruik via credits

en.tagline: AI employees that handle email, calendar and follow-ups
en.description: Lindy lets you build AI agents ('Lindies') for recurring work: triaging and answering email, scheduling meetings, following up leads and processing meeting notes, connected to your existing apps. There is a trial but no free plan.
bestFor: Entrepreneurs offloading inbox and follow-up work
notFor: People who want full technical control (consider n8n)
